er_v06_c09_n101_01: A young woman comes to the window and sets her shoulder bag casually on the counter edge.
er_v06_c09_n101_02: Oh, this alley is even narrower than I thought.
er_v06_c09_n101_03: I asked three people, and they all said you don't cheat anyone here.
er_v06_c09_n101_04: That counts as a compliment, right?
er_v06_c09_n101_07: How many years have you been open here?
er_v06_c09_n101_09: A few. Just minding a room full of old things.
er_v06_c09_n101_10: ...I didn't mean it like that. I talk fast. Don't take it to heart.
er_v06_c09_n101_11: She unclasps her bag, digs out an old-fashioned metal bracelet, and sets it casually on the counter.
er_v06_c09_n101_12: Dug it out of the bottom of an old storage box at home. Looks dull and way out of style.
er_v06_c09_n101_13: Just sitting there gathering dust—how much can I get for it?
er_v06_c09_n101_15: I don't know quality on old things like this.
er_v06_c09_n101_16: Give me whatever you think is fair. I won't haggle.
er_v06_c09_n102_01: The bracelet is turned over. A razor-fine old serial mark runs inside the band.
er_v06_c09_n102_02: Huh—there's actually writing inside? I didn't even notice.
er_v06_c09_n102_03: ...Probably just some old shop mark from years ago. Sharp eyes.
er_v06_c09_n102_05: You're not going to ask where it came from?
er_v06_c09_n102_08: The bracelet goes into a wooden box under the counter. The lid snaps shut.
er_v06_c09_n102_09: You didn't try to cheat me on the price.
er_v06_c09_n102_10: I had a whole speech ready. Wasted.
er_v06_c09_n103_03: A friend. Her mother had trouble, she got sent down, won't see anyone.
er_v06_c09_n103_04: Once I say that, you should know who.
er_v06_c09_n103_05: She puts the bracelet back in her bag and fastens it.
er_v06_c09_n104_02: You didn't even check the quality before saying no.
er_v06_c09_n104_04: She puts the bracelet away and fastens her bag.
er_v06_c09_n105_01: The bracelet is turned over. A razor-fine old serial mark runs inside the band.

er_v06_c09_n105_08: The bracelet goes into a wooden box under the counter. The lid snaps shut.
er_v06_c09_n105_09: You cut the price like it was nothing.
er_v06_c09_n105_10: I thought you'd at least pretend to hesitate.
er_v06_c09_n106_01: Has a girl come by lately? Selling something?
er_v06_c09_n106_02: Upper-level accent, sharp tongue, about this tall, face longer than the shelves.
er_v06_c09_n106_05: We grew up together. As soon as her mother got into trouble, my family wouldn't even let me mention her name.
er_v06_c09_n106_06: I called her. Told her to come stay at my place.
er_v06_c09_n106_07: She answered with two words: no need. Then hung up.
er_v06_c09_n106_08: I was so mad I didn't sleep half the night. Next day I still texted her.
er_v06_c09_n106_09: She didn't answer a single one.
er_v06_c09_n106_11: I just want to know if she's been eating.
er_v06_c09_n106_12: Leave the bracelet with you for now.
er_v06_c09_n106_13: I'll come redeem it in a few days.
